notes: This contract maps the ordinary interaction callback-control scenarios to the direct IEEE 1516.1-2025 requirements in §10.60.6. The immediate-model assertion verifies that a pending Receive Interaction callback remains undispatched between Disable Callbacks and Enable Callbacks. The evoked-model scenario exercises callback servicing separately; it is not used to widen the immediate-model requirement claim.

requirements.statement: In HLA_IMMEDIATE mode, after Disable Callbacks and a published ordinary Send Interaction, no Receive Interaction callback is exposed before Enable Callbacks; after Enable Callbacks, the pending callback is delivered.
The scenario waits for the baseline Receive Interaction callback to return before invoking Disable Callbacks, so the service is not invoked while a callback is in progress.
